effects.effect: The ash you leave behind burns your foes. The first time on a [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn) that you use a shadow ability to [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport) away from or into a space [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to an enemy, that enemy takes fire damage equal to your [Agility](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/agility) score.
